description: Frozen sentence-embedding encoder (sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, revision b9db1e8a0d3a51769172ba8546f282a73f066e47, Apache-2.0, English, 384 dims, 256 wordpieces) + Linear SVM (LinearSVC) classifier. Local CPU inference only; no remote API calls.
feature_representation: MiniLM-L6-v2 frozen embeddings (384-dimensional), optionally PCA-reduced to 64 or 128 components (training-fold fitted)
encoder_inference: Local CPU; cached embeddings keyed by text checksum and encoder revision
embedding_cache: data/cache/embeddings/ (local, ignored by Git; keyed by text checksum + encoder revision)
artifact_note: Embedding weights are NOT duplicated across folders. The encoder is loaded once locally. Development-only fitted classifier can be saved with models/sentence_embeddings_linear_svm/run.py --save-artifact. Production release is models/releases/linear-svc-primary-v2/ (lexical TF-IDF LinearSVC, not embeddings).
